notes.title: Project Tarvotan - Update 1.04 (Easy Difficulty Mode)
notes.content:
Hello all,

Today I am very pleased to announce the much requested feature of difficulty modes for Project Tarvotan is now live in our latest update!  To celebrate another community requested feature successfully being implemented in our game we have launched a 66% off sale for the next few days!


Other notable changes in this update are:
    
     New Main Menu UI
     Minor Revisions to In-Game UI
     Groundwork for Saving System in future update
     Groundwork for future update to Questing System
     Balancing and numbers adjustments
     


We at Noyer Game Studios are proud to answer to feedback from our players and fans, and as always we ask you to never hesistate to reach out to us if you have questions, concerns, or comments.  Thank you all for your support and happy gaming!

notes.title: Project Tarvotan - Community Content Update #3 (Coming Soon)
notes.content:
We're proud to announce that we will be releasing an update for Project Tarvotan as the holiday season arrives. We love recieving community feedback, and we currently have plans to integrate some greatly requested features into this update. 

One of the most requested features that we are currently in the process of integrating is a 'Saving/Loading' system. Many community members have requested this feature, so we are extremely proud to announce that we plan on including this feature in our upcoming update.

A revised 'Heads Up Display' will also be included. This change is intended to clean up the current UI, and provide a fresh experience when intereacting with the HUD. 

Quests will be recieving a slight update. More quests will be included for each sector, and we'll be tweaking the process of accepting a quest to make it a little bit clearer.

These are just some of the changes that we're planning. Everything that I mentioned here, I can confirm will make it into this update. There are also other addons, changes, and tweaks that we are going to try and include, but we are not currently able to confirm them for this update. 

These changes will also be listed in more detail in the official annoucement that we release when the update offically launches. As far as a timetable goes for this update, we are planning on releasing it within a few weeks.

A rough date would be December 23rd, but it's extremely possible that we'll release it before then. As always, I want to thank everyone who has left feedback for Project Tarvotan, without suggestions from you, none of this would be possible, so we would like to thank you!

I personally hope everyone has a great holiday season and we look forward to providing you with more information soon!

Happy Holidays and Cheers!

notes.title: Project Tarvotan - Community Content Update #2 (Tarvopedia)
notes.content:
We have released an update for Project Tarvotan that has added an entirely new feature, called the 'Tarvopedia'. 

The Tarvopedia can be launched from the menu screen. This new feature is intended to contain information regarding all of Project Tarvotan's gameplay elements. It provides a detailed description on each specific element of gameplay. We hope that this reduces the learning curve and promotes clarity and understanding for newcomers to Project Tarvotan.

Additionally, we would like to also announce that we have permanently reduced the price of Project Tarvotan to just $7.99! 

We will continue to offer community content updates at the discretion of the Steam community! This was a community inspired update, so we would like to thank you for helping make Project Tarvotan as popular and fun as possible.

notes.title: Project Tarvotan - Community Content Update (Trading Cards)
notes.content:
We've previously expressed interest in integrating some of Steam's exclusive features into Project Tarvotan, and we're really proud to announce that our first community content update will feature the addition of Trading Cards. 

We are planning on launching Trading Cards in the first week of October, although this process takes some time, so this information is subject to change.

We will continue to offer community content updates at the discretion of the Steam community and all of our partners to try and make Project Tarvotan as popular and enjoyable as possible.
